title: Ergon — Frequency, 4K for Windows
author: Frequency, PRISM
notes: Breakpoint 2010, 4K intro: a march through a landscape of noise, its height map a 1024x1024 float16 texture filled once by a texture shader of its own (tx_1_0, Perlin's noise()) through D3DXFillTextureTX, then raymarched in an HLSL pixel shader drawn through Direct3D 9, with synthesized music through waveOut; packed by Crinkler. MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9_42.dll in JavaScript; PRISM's d3d9.js evaluates the texture shader, its noise() as D3DX computes it, and translates the HLSL to GLSL ES for WebGL2.
